# kener_incident (Data Source)

Fetches a single Kener incident by its numeric id, including its status-update comments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kener_incident" "outage" {
  id = "42"
}

output "outage_state" {
  value = data.kener_incident.outage.state
}

# All status updates on the incident, in order.
output "outage_comments" {
  value = data.kener_incident.outage.comments
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the incident.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (Attributes List) Status-update comments on this incident. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--comments))
- `end_date_time` (Number) End time (Unix seconds).
- `incident_source` (String) Incident source.
- `incident_type` (String) Incident type.
- `monitors` (Attributes List) Monitors affected by this incident. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--monitors))
- `start_date_time` (Number) Start time (Unix seconds).
- `state` (String) Current incident state.
- `title` (String) Incident title.
- `url` (String) Absolute public URL.

<a id="nestedatt--comments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `comments`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Comment body.
- `id` (String) Comment id.
- `state` (String) Incident state at this update.
- `timestamp` (Number) Comment time (Unix seconds).


<a id="nestedatt--monitors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `monitors`

Read-Only:

- `impact` (String) Impact level.
- `monitor_tag` (String) Affected monitor tag.
